modalities.evidence: two sets of physiological signals: auditory brainstem response (ABR) and otoacoustic emissions (OAE)

output.population: Normals (normal-hearing listeners) in a study examining evoked potentials and loudness growth
output.summary: Auditory brainstem response and otoacoustic emission recordings together with psychoacoustical estimates of loudness as a function of peak sound pressure level, from a study of evoked potentials and loudness growth.
